text:
Priya (CS): Heads up - NovaTech renewal next week. They're asking to change term from 12mo -> 9mo, add 15 seats, and split invoicing across EU and US entities. Also asking if onboarding credit can be applied pro rata to the shorter term. Any immediate blockers?
Sam (Sales): Do we have a pricing impact for 9mo vs 12mo? They want same unit price but shorter term.
Priya (CS): Customer wants same unit price; procurement insists on separate invoices. Potential risk: legal/PO timing.
Tom (Legal): Separate invoices ok. Need both PO numbers and tax IDs. I can draft a short amendment for the term change and credit allocation.
Maria (Billing): Invoice split is doable but requires vendor codes and billing contacts. EU invoices need VAT handling.
Priya (CS): If they accept proration, can onboarding credit be split across both invoices?
Maria (Billing): Credits apply at billing account level, but we can distribute the credit pro rata if required. Need approval on allocation.
Sam (Sales): We'll keep unit price flat. @Tom, can you add clause: "Onboarding credit will be applied pro rata across invoices for the 9-month term"?
Tom (Legal): Yep, will add a 2-line amendment and route for e-sign.
BillingBot: Draft invoice preview:
```
INVOICE DRAFT
NovaTech EU (Entity A) - 9,375 - 9mo prorated seats
NovaTech US (Entity B) - $6,250 - remaining seats
Onboarding credit: 9,000 applied pro rata
```
Priya (CS): Also request: schedule enablement within first 30 days and a go-live checklist. Can PMs commit?
Sam (Sales): I'll cover enablement sessions - 2 sessions + materials included.
Tom (Legal): Amendment will include onboarding timeline and acceptance criteria.
Maria (Billing): Once amendment is signed, I can issue two invoices and apply credit. Need vendor codes and PO numbers by EOD Thursday.
Priya (CS): I'll collect PO/vendor codes and confirm onboarding dates. Thanks team :rocket:
